adjudicates: nothing; a census of the label pool, counts only, no score

snapshots.rule: a row is FV-graded when its fv column is set; the window is source_backtest's preseason window on the snapshot date; real_grader is False for the non-rater and constant-anchor sources

frame.rule: a row is a (player, V) with a real grader published inside the V preseason window and no major league line before V; id_how is the outcome-blind resolver's route (efv_identity), record_id is the record's stored id (audit only, never an input)

reserved_copied.quote: V 2020 (W3 resolvable now: 821 hit / 478 pit rows) and V 2021 (W3 resolves at the 2026 freeze: 906 / 462)

debut_cohorts.window: the debut year's preseason window (efv_vintage_frame.window_bounds), closed at the debut day
debut_cohorts.rule: in_window_consensus_read: a point inside the window with a consensus_fv; fangraphs_and_pipeline_both: both SCORED_SOURCES published an fv inside the window; with_career_war_row: the player_key has a career_war row (presence only, no value read)

bust_pool.rule: id_1_birth_1 means the record carries an mlbam_id and a birth date; the last list year is the latest snapshot year on the record's points; the no-id no-birth rows flip to never when that year is at or before RESOLVED_THROUGH - NEVER_LIST_LAG

identity_join.rule: provider is the stored row's source field; the id route is the first of: the debuts.json record carries an mlbam_id, the key is in data/sources/mlbam_id_overrides.json, the key is in debuts.json without an id, the key is not in debuts.json

label_views.rule: counts only: a vintage's rows are the frame rows of (b) (R-LV copied, never built); a cohort's debuts are the rows of (c); faithfulness numbers are parsed from the committed PROGRAM.md text and are label-to-label, no rater enters

rows.definition: first six MLB seasons, censored tail projected (efv_dataset._label_6yr)
rows.standing: the training label and F-VM scoring label

rows.definition: WAR over the first three MLB seasons, 0 if no debut in V..V+3
WAR over the first two MLB seasons, 0 if no debut in V..V+3
rows.standing: hazard component, not a scoring label

faithfulness_to_six_season.note: PROGRAM.md s2.2: W2, R3 and AA2 lose the grader ordering or are hazard components; not scoring labels

rows.standing: timing-head target only, not a scoring label

rows.standing: the R-VM look-1 label by design

floor_curve.rule: the scaling PROGRAM.md s2.5 already uses; a floor of a different frame type is not a function of n alone (LANE_A.md s2); the lv E_refit floor is unmeasured (EV-05 owes it) and is not drawn

epoch: the eFV label is in an epoch (docs/efv-2026-09-17/FWAR_LABEL_EPOCH_GATE.md); label.provider and label.resolved_through stamp this census, and a run after the epoch is a new census, never an edit of this one
